# Stillframe Stock Imagery — licensing terms (extract)

Standard issuance: licences are issued on the weekly licensing run. Rush issuance: USD 260 flat per request. Every licence is countersigned by the customer's brand legal counsel and registered in the customer's DAM; a licence is usable the next business day after issue. Territory grants are exact: a grant covers only the territories printed on it.

Quotes are valid until the printed date. Superseded quotes (for example SFQ-90287) must not be used for scheduling.
